prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440×900 landscape. Primary request: Design a shippable Russian travel-planning PWA screen called «Туту План Б» in a BRIGHT WAYFINDING PAVILION visual system. This is an operating interface, not a poster. First viewport: a slim friendly header; a compact trip title Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург; a huge interactive stylized globe centered and occupying about 48% of the viewport, with accurate-looking simplified continents, saturated blue ocean, one warm coral route arc, clear origin/destination nodes and tiny transport markers; a route summary rail at right; three route modes Надёжный, Сбалансированный, Бюджетный; and a horizontal sequence of transport–hotel–return stages along the lower third. World: contemporary public wayfinding and bright departure-hall signage, daylight white and pale cool-blue ground, deep ink navy, vivid violet, warm coral primary action, sunny yellow risk highlights, mint success. Typography: confident rounded grotesk signage with strong Russian legibility, large route labels and compact tabular metrics. Controls are shaped like real wayfinding plates, not generic rounded cards. Show demo mode clearly. Use real product states: structural resilience 87%, one stage with «План Б», price around 84 600 ₽ labeled as demo data. Signature interaction implied: selecting a route stage lights the matching globe arc and pulls its strip forward. Text that must appear verbatim where legible: «Туту План Б», «Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург», «Надёжный», «Сбалансированный», «Бюджетный», «План Б», «Демо-данные». Input image role: visual mood only for the centered rounded planet and travel-marker energy; do not copy its watermark, exact icons, orbit, background or composition. Constraints: accessible high contrast, believable production UI, generous but information-dense, no stock bento grid, no dark neon mission control, no glassmorphism, no purple gradient background, no fake photography, no watermark. IMPORTANT: the globe is the unmistakable center of the composition but the interface remains usable.
